title: Dependable event overview
summary: Event and invitation lists now stay clear and recoverable when requests are interrupted.
highlights: Event loading failures are distinct from an empty list and provide a direct retry.
Event refresh failures preserve previously loaded event cards while reporting that newer data is unavailable.
Pending invitation loading failures remain visible instead of disappearing as an empty list.
Interrupted invitation acceptance safely reconciles on retry while keeping the invitation available until acceptance is confirmed.
Interrupted invitation decline safely reconciles on retry while keeping the confirmation controls available until decline is confirmed.

title: Clearer recovery and navigation
summary: Coordination surfaces now distinguish unavailable data from empty results, with safer retries and truthful mobile navigation state.
highlights: Friend requests and event wishlists show recoverable loading failures instead of misleading empty content.
Comment and reservation actions stay hidden until their current state is known, with duplicate-safe retries when loading fails.
The mobile navigation toggle reports its open or closed state to assistive technology.

title: More flexible gift exchanges
summary: Gift Exchange is now the clearer home for private name draws, with Secret Santa available as an optional familiar style.
highlights: Gift Exchange now describes the private assignment feature across the app, so it fits holidays, birthdays, teams, and family traditions.
Secret Santa is available as a persistent exchange style, and existing exchanges retain that familiar style after upgrading.
Style-aware setup updates name examples, date and budget guidance, readiness language, and assignment confirmations to match your group.

title: Safer wishlist item deletion
summary: Removing a wishlist idea is now consistent, focus-safe, duplicate-resistant, and recoverable without losing the current view.
highlights: Grid and list views use the same accessible wishlist-item deletion confirmation.
Delete controls prevent duplicate requests and clearly show removal progress.
Failed deletions stay in the dialog with safe retry guidance.
Successful deletion updates the current view without resetting search, filters, sorting, or layout.
Repeated requests safely reconcile a completed deletion while unexpected responses surface as failures.

title: Dependable wishlist item editing
summary: Adding, editing, and importing wishlist items now stays clear and recoverable without duplicate requests or lost details.
highlights: Wishlist-item saves prevent duplicate requests and clearly show when an add or edit is in progress.
Save failures stay in the item dialog with safe guidance, while stable request keys make repeated add attempts idempotent.
Successful adds and edits update the visible wishlist immediately without bypassing viewer privacy rules.
Product-link imports validate web addresses and prevent overlapping paste or button requests.
Product imports preserve the entered link and distinguish imported details, a usable link without details, and a retryable failure.

title: Clearer wishlist overview
summary: Wishlist overview now makes saved ideas, sharing status, and the next useful action easier to see.
highlights: The wishlist overview shows total lists, saved ideas, and shared lists at a glance.
Shared wishlists have a clear purpose and a direct route to friend management.
An empty shared-with-you tab explains what is missing and offers a Find friends action.

title: Dependable event participation
summary: Event pages now recover clearly from loading and update failures while protecting edits, participant removal, and invitation decisions.
highlights: Event details distinguish loading failures from loading progress and provide clear, duplicate-safe retry and exit actions.
Event management distinguishes loading failures from loading progress without implying that settings were changed, and safely redirects non-organizers.
Event edits prevent duplicate saves, announce completion, and keep actionable failures on the form.
Participant removal requires confirmation, prevents duplicate requests, and safely reconciles interrupted results while keeping participant views in sync.
Invitation declines require confirmation, explain the consequence, and never expose internal failure details.

title: Clearer account access
summary: Account access now gives people clearer guidance when signing in, creating an account, or recovering access.
highlights: Sign-in explains when a session stays active, warns against using that option on shared devices, and groups account-recovery actions.
Registration shows the complete password requirements before submission and provides a direct route back to sign-in.
Password recovery explains its privacy-preserving result, uses email-friendly input, and provides a safe return to sign-in.
Password reset shows the complete password requirements and names the action's outcome clearly.
Confirmation-email recovery explains its privacy behavior, uses email-friendly input, and provides a safe return to sign-in.

title: Safer two-factor settings
summary: Two-factor authentication settings now make account protection, setup, recovery, and potentially disruptive actions easier to understand.
highlights: Two-factor settings show whether protection is on or off and prioritize the next useful action.
Authenticator setup provides a truthful manual-key workflow and a mobile-friendly verification-code field.
Recovery-code replacement explains that existing codes will stop working, keeps a safe exit visible, and presents new codes as an accessible list.
Authenticator reset explains its immediate effect and keeps the current authenticator as the first action.
Turning off 2FA explains the reduced protection, preserves a safe exit, and confirms the resulting account state.

title: Clearer account settings
summary: Account settings now make identity, sign-in, and personal-data choices easier to understand and safer to navigate on any screen.
highlights: Account navigation remains labelled, reachable, and comfortably sized on smaller screens.
Profile settings explain read-only and optional fields, support phone autofill, and clearly name the save action.
Email settings show confirmation in text and explain when a changed address takes effect.
Password settings connect the complete enforced length and character requirements to the new-password field.
Personal-data actions name their outcomes and provide a clear safe exit before account deletion.

title: Dependable wishlist management
summary: Wishlist navigation and management now stay accessible, truthful, and recoverable when loading or updates are interrupted.
highlights: Wishlist cards provide explicit named links for keyboard and screen-reader navigation.
Wishlist settings expose loading progress and offer an actionable retry when loading fails.
Friend-access failures remain distinct from a genuinely empty access list.
Friend-access controls have clear names, visible labels, readable contrast, duplicate-change protection, announced outcomes, and comfortable touch targets.
Event connections distinguish loading failures from having no available events and provide safe retry guidance.

title: Dependable event coordination
summary: Event invitations, pairing rules, gift-exchange actions, and deletion now remain clear and recoverable when requests fail.
highlights: Event deletion failures are checked before retry so completed deletions are never repeated.
Pairing-rule loading failures are distinct from an empty rule list and provide a retry action.
Pairing-rule changes are idempotent, reconcile interrupted responses, and announce their outcome.
Drawing names and resetting a gift exchange reconcile interrupted responses before another action is offered.
Invitation loading, friend selection, and invitation actions expose progress, recovery, and completion.

title: Truthful loading and friend actions
summary: Wishlist, friend, and dashboard workflows now communicate loading and failures more clearly while protecting repeated actions.
highlights: Personal wishlist failures appear as actionable errors instead of empty results.
Friends' wishlist failures remain distinct from a genuinely empty shared list.
Friend invitations expose progress, prevent duplicate sends, and explain authentication or delivery failures.
Friend loading and removal provide retryable errors, named controls, accurate sharing consequences, duplicate-action protection, and completion feedback.
The personalized dashboard exposes its loading state to assistive technology.

title: Comfortable mobile controls
summary: Wishlist and Secret Santa actions are easier to reach on phones without obscuring nearby content.
highlights: The mobile add-item action stays in the wishlist flow with a visible label instead of floating over content.
Wishlist item edit and delete actions have explicit names and comfortable mobile touch targets.
Wishlist filter, sort, and view controls provide consistent 44-pixel mobile touch targets.
Secret Santa setup actions expand safely on small screens and meet the mobile touch-target guideline.
Comment deletion and reservation release confirmations provide larger mobile actions.

title: Dependable creation and dialogs
summary: Wishlist creation and confirmation workflows now provide safer keyboard behavior and truthful progress and failure states.
highlights: Confirmation dialogs contain keyboard focus, close with Escape, and return focus to their opener.
Wishlist visibility uses native, mutually exclusive radio choices with dependable keyboard focus.
Wishlist creation prevents duplicate submissions and keeps actionable failures on the form.
Standalone item creation prevents duplicate submissions and keeps actionable failures on the form.
Secret Santa assignment failures provide a clear retry action instead of appearing as no assignment.

title: Safer coordination actions
summary: Event navigation, reservations, comments, and friend requests now provide clearer keyboard behavior and dependable feedback.
highlights: Event cards provide an explicit, named navigation link for keyboard and screen-reader users.
Reserved-item refreshes announce progress and results, and identify links that open a new tab.
Friend-request actions name the person involved, prevent duplicate updates, and announce outcomes.
Comment deletion requires a focused confirmation and explains that removal is permanent.
Reservation cancellation requires a focused confirmation and explains when the item becomes available again.

title: Clearer discovery and notifications
summary: Wishlist discovery, friend invitations, and notification actions now provide faster and more dependable feedback.
highlights: Wishlist discovery filters immediately, includes a clear action, and announces empty results.
Friend invitations connect guidance and feedback while preventing empty submission.
The notification panel communicates its open state, keeps background controls unavailable, and manages keyboard focus.
Notification deletion clearly names the item, explains permanence, and begins on the safe action.
Notification updates expose busy, success, and failure states.

title: Accessible wishlist browsing
summary: Wishlist discovery and item capture now communicate their controls and current state more clearly.
highlights: Item search announces matching ideas and provides a clearly named reset action.
Filters and sorting communicate which options are active.
Grid and list controls identify the current view.
Product URL import fields include connected guidance and prevent empty imports.
The add-item dialog starts at the product URL, contains keyboard focus, and returns it to the opener when closed.

title: Accessible event coordination
summary: Event coordination controls now give keyboard and screen-reader users clearer state and context.
highlights: Invitation filters announce their selected status and matching invitations.
Invitation and removal dialogs identify their purpose, choices, and consequences.
Wishlist attachment and pairing-rule controls keep their visible labels connected.

title: Clearer gift coordination controls
summary: Wishlist and event controls now provide clearer context when using a keyboard or screen reader.
highlights: Wishlist tabs, search controls, and results communicate their current content and state.
Gift reservation and comment controls identify when their details are open.
Event deletion confirmation clearly describes its permanent consequence.

title: Reliable release versioning
summary: OpenWish builds now report the same version as the current release.
highlights: Compiled assembly metadata, release information, and the What's new page stay synchronized.

title: Google sign-in handoff
summary: Google sign-in can now navigate to Google's authorization page.
highlights: The browser form destination policy permits Google's authorization origin only when Google sign-in is configured.

title: Google sign-in route
summary: Google sign-in submits to the correct account endpoint.
highlights: The login form uses the root-relative external authentication route.

title: Clearer loading updates
summary: Loading updates now say what OpenWish is working on.
highlights: Screen readers receive contextual loading updates without duplicate announcements from decorative button spinners.

title: Clearer product links
summary: Product links now make it clearer where they lead.
highlights: Wishlist product links identify the item they open for screen-reader users and safely open in a new tab.

title: Sustainable improvements
summary: A stronger foundation for consistent product updates and verified releases.
highlights: Release highlights are now available directly in OpenWish.
Wishlist, event, and friend pages share a clearer visual hierarchy.
Browser verification covers owner, guest, and friend journeys across desktop and mobile layouts.
A verified walkthrough demonstrates wishlists, events, gift exchange, friends, notifications, and responsive use.
An isolated agent-managed environment can be promoted without changing the developer's Aspire data or ports.
Private social, event, notification, activity, and reservation data is now protected by stricter authorization and privacy controls.
Self-hosted deployments now include safer login, proxy, browser, email, and product-link defaults.
Google sign-in now recovers unconfirmed linked accounts through email confirmation instead of asking users to link again.
Notification deletion now updates immediately and reports failures instead of closing without feedback.
Creation forms now focus their first useful field, and wishlists include a compact icon picker.
Invitation registration now clearly keeps the email address that received the invitation.
Wishlist collaboration actions now consistently use the signed-in user's identity.
Local time formatting is safer and accurate across partial-hour time zones.
